wizard.installerHint: A single script that lays the box out correctly: it creates the service user and the update-slot layout, writes both files above, installs the systemd unit, then starts the service. Run it as root with the binary and the unit file: sudo sh install-pos-edge.sh ./pos-edge ./pos-edge.service. Running it twice is safe.

wizard.keyIssued: API key issued — copy it now, it will not be shown again.
